method: DMA is a Triton fused attention kernel that assigns higher precision to diagonal and sink regions, lower-bit MXFP formats elsewhere, and integrates quantization, microscaling conversion, packing, and attention computation.
problem: The paper addresses the quadratic attention cost and high-precision memory-bandwidth burden that make transformer LLM inference expensive.
